newsitem.title: USA: ICG Communications to switch to Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: ICG Communications to switch to Nasdaq.

text.p: ICG Communications Inc said on Thursday that effective March 25 it will switch to the Nasdaq National Market from the American Stock Exchange, and that its common stock will trade under the symbol "ICGX."
The operations of ICG Communications Inc consist of ICG Telecom Group Inc, ICG Fiber Optic Technologies Inc and ICG Satellite Services Inc.

Telecom Group is ICG's Competitive Local Exchange Carrier ("CLEC") and enhanced services business with primary markets in California, Ohio, Colorado, Texas and in various southeastern regions. Fiber Optic Technologies provides network integration and support services.
Satellite Services provides maritime telecommunications network and international end-to-end voice and data services, and operates VSAT (very small aperture terminal) private data networks.
ICG shares were trading at 13-3/8 on Thursday, unchanged on the day. Their 52-week high was 27-3/8.
